title: Production of Vowel Reduction by Mexican Learners of English as L2 and Russian as L3
why_promising: Primary multilingual production from 35 speakers across Mexican Spanish, American English, Russian, L2 English and L3 Russian. The first author manually transcribed and segmented all productions in Praat; 1,192 retained vowel tokens have midpoint F1/F2, duration, Lobanov-normalized values and derived Euclidean-distance vowel-reduction measures, with task and language/group structure documented.
